description: Discard schedule 'one from four races scored, two from eight': with eight races scored, each boat's two worst scores are excluded.
citation: RRS 2025-2028 A2.1: the notice of race may provide 'that two or more scores will be excluded, or that a specified number of scores will be excluded if a specified number of races are scored'. Eight races reaches this schedule's second threshold, so two scores are excluded. A4 scores the places.
working: Eight races scored reaches the second threshold, so the discard count is 2.
R1-R4 as in the first-threshold vector. R5: A 1, B 2, C 3, D 4. R6: B 1, C 2, D 3, A 4. R7: C 1, D 2, A 3, B 4. R8: D 1, A 2, B 3, C 4.
A 1,3,1,4,1,4,3,2: gross 19; her two 4s (R4, R6) are excluded; net 11.
B 2,1,4,1,2,1,4,3: gross 18; her two 4s (R3, R7) are excluded; net 10.
C 3,4,3,3,3,2,1,4: gross 23; her two 4s (R2, R8) are excluded; net 15.
D 4,2,2,2,4,3,2,1: gross 20; her two 4s (R1, R5) are excluded; net 12.
Each boat has exactly two 4s and nothing else as bad, so which scores are excluded is never in doubt. No two nets are equal: B, A, D, C.
